S6:12.text: Abraham adored before the people of the land.

S6:13.text: And he ſpoke to Ephron, his people ſtanding round about: I beſeech thee to heare me: I wil giue money for the field: take it and ſo I wil burie my dead in it.

S6:16.text: Which when Abraham had heard, he weyghed the money that Ephron had asked in the hearing of the children of Heth, foure hundred ſicles of ſiluer of common currant money.

S6:17.text: And the field that before time was Ephrons, wherin was the double caue, looking towards Mambre, as wel it, as the caue, and al the trees therof in al the limits thereof round about,

S6:18.text: was made ſure to Abraham for a poſſeſſion, in the ſight of the children of Heth, and of. al that went in at the gate of his, citie.

S6:7.text: Abraham roſe vp and adored the people of the land, towit the children of Heth;

S9:10.text: And Ephron dwelt in the middeſt of the children of Heth. And Ephron made anſwer to Abraham in the hearing of al that went in at the gate of the citie, ſaying:

S9:12.text: Abraham adored before the people of the land.

S9:2.text: And ſhe died in the citie of Arbee which is a Hebron in the land of Chanaan: And Abraham came to mourne, and weepe for her.

S9:4.text: I am a ſtranger and pilgrime among you: geue me the right of a ſepulchre with you, that I may burie my dead.

S9:5.text: The children of Heth anſwered, ſaying

S9:6.text: My lord heare vs, thou art a prince of God among vs: in our principal ſepulchres burie thou thy dead and no man can let thee but that in his owne monument thou mayeſt burie thy dead.

S9:7.text: Abraham roſe vp, and :: adored the people of the land, rowit the children of Heth:

S9:8.text: and he ſaid to them If it pleaſe your ſoule that I burie my dead, heare me, and be interceſſors for me to Ephron the ſonne of Seor
